title: Display Push Probability & Key-Number Equity Bar Alongside Point Spreads
current_repo_state: Legacy `src/own6/lines.py` uses continuous NBA normal CDF (`erf`) which assigns 0% push mass and treats `-2.5 -> -3.0` identically to `-4.5 -> -5.0`
decision_problem_solved: In NFL buying or moving across `3` (~8-9% of games) or `7` (~6-7% of games) dominates EV; continuous normal CDF misstates NFL spread edges by 1.5%-3.5%
option_paths_for_review: Path A: Show `P(Win) / P(Loss) / P(Push)` + `Key_3_Mass` & `Key_7_Mass` columns in every NFL line table; Path B: Half-point value lookup table
recommended_path: Path A + Path B powered by `originate_nfl_game()` discrete margin PMF
prerequisites_before_implementing: Calibrate post-2025 integer margin multipliers on authorized 2025-2026 NFL final scores (`N >= 408` games)
effort_and_reversibility: Low effort · Essential for NFL spread accuracy

title: Show 'Sportsbook Implicit Correlation Tax' Column Before Allowing Any Combo Evaluation
current_repo_state: Most analytics dashboards show model joint probability without comparing against single-leg vig compounding plus extra sportsbook SGP shading
decision_problem_solved: Prevents betting positively correlated SGPs (e.g. QB Pass Over + WR1 Rec Over) where sportsbook SGP pricing already overcharges beyond the copula lift
option_paths_for_review: Path A: Mandatory 3-number display (`Indep_Fair_Odds` | `Copula_Correlated_Fair_Odds` | `Book_Quoted_Odds_&_Tax`); Path B: Hard-block SGPs with >8% implicit hold
prerequisites_before_implementing: Licensed single-leg two-way prop quotes + simultaneous SGP price quotes + training-only residual correlation CI
effort_and_reversibility: Medium effort · High protection against SGP hold traps

title: Promote Same-Line De-Vigged CLV & Brier Skill Score Above Raw Win-Loss ROI on Leaderboards
current_repo_state: Human reviewers instinctively sort leaderboards by raw win% or short-term ROI which in NFL (`14-16` games/week) is ~80% noise over half a season
decision_problem_solved: Stops lucky 12-3 small-sample heaters from earning research rewards while identifying genuinely sharp models during temporary post-snap turnover variance
option_paths_for_review: Path A: Primary sort by `SkillScore` (`LCB95_ROI + CLV + BrierEdge`) with raw ROI shown secondary in muted text; Path B: Hide ROI until N >= 250
prerequisites_before_implementing: Timestamped closing-line sidecar ledger at identical spread/total numbers
effort_and_reversibility: Low effort · Core anti-luck governance upgrade
